blocks.text: Product Description               Rich and buttery OI is Davines' miracle conditioner for all hair types, from normal, dull strands to aging hair. Providing extraordinary softness, shine and body, accelerating the drying process and leaving the hair with a salon-worthy scent. Pair any Davines moisturizing shampoo and conditioner with a finishing OI milk spray, OI oil, or serum for salon shine and all-day hydration.                  Brand Story               Davines is an international beauty dedicated to a balance of beauty and sustainability. All products are care-crafted in Parma, Italy using the highest-quality natural ingredients and scientific rigor.
